column2: The dark frame accentuates the bright colors in the painting.
column3: 深色的畫框突顯了畫中明亮的色彩。
column5: accent 是口音或重音，加上重音就是特別強調

column2: In her speech, the mayor highlighted the need for safer bridges.
column3: 市長在演講中點出了興建更安全橋梁的必要。
column5: 用螢光筆 highlighter 在課本上劃出重點

column2: Our teacher emphasized that every answer must be supported by evidence.
column3: 老師強調每個答案都必須有證據支持。
column5: 把重點放大一個 size，就是 emphasize

column2: The model is purely theoretical, because no experiment has yet confirmed its predictions.
column3: 這個模型純屬理論上的，因為還沒有實驗證實它的預測。
column5: theory 加 -ical：只存在理論裡，還沒實際做過

column2: The biologist's hypothesis was that warmer water would speed up the frogs' growth.
column3: 這位生物學家的假說是：較溫暖的水會加快青蛙的生長。
column5: hypo 在下面 + thesis 論點：先放在底下、等著被檢驗的論點

column2: Scientists hypothesize that a giant asteroid caused the dinosaurs to disappear.
column3: 科學家假設是一顆巨大的小行星使恐龍消失的。
column5: hypothesis 把 -is 換成 -ize，名詞變動詞：提出假說

column2: Einstein postulated that the speed of light is the same for every observer.
column3: 愛因斯坦假定光速對每位觀察者而言都相同。
column4: postulate a theory (提出理論假定)
column5: 想像把假定釘在公布欄 post 上，再讓大家來檢驗

column2: The argument's premise, that every citizen read the notice, was never proven.
column3: 這個論證的前提是每位市民都讀過公告，但這從未被證實。
column5: pre 先 + mise 送出：先端上桌的話，就是整個論證的前提

column2: Her assertion that the river was safe to cross turned out to be wrong.
column3: 她斷言河水可以安全渡過，結果卻是錯的。
column5: 想像有人雙手叉腰、大聲宣布：我才是對的！

column2: The defendant asserted his innocence even after the evidence was presented.
column3: 即使證據已經呈上，被告仍堅稱自己是清白的。
column4: assert one's innocence (堅稱自己無辜)
column5: 諧音「阿瘦特」：阿瘦挺胸堅稱「我沒偷吃」

column2: Critics contend that the new law favors large companies over small farms.
column3: 批評者主張這項新法偏袒大企業而非小農。
column5: con 一起 + tend 伸展：雙方伸手互爭，各自提出主張

column2: Despite the doubts, the scientist maintained that her data were accurate.
column3: 儘管有人質疑，這位科學家仍堅持她的數據是準確的。
column5: main 手 + tain 握：用手緊握不放，就是堅持

column2: The author posits that loneliness spreads through social networks like a contagion.
column3: 作者主張孤獨感會像傳染病一樣，在社交網絡中擴散。
column5: 像 position 立場：把一個立場放到桌面上

column2: Teaching a child to swim presupposes that the water is safe.
column3: 教孩子游泳，是以水域安全為先決條件的。
column4: presuppose the existence of (預設……存在)
column5: pre 先 + suppose 假設：先假設好，後面才說得通

column2: The detective found the alibi implausible because the train it named never ran on Sundays.
column3: 偵探覺得這個不在場證明難以置信，因為它提到的那班火車週日根本不開。
column4: an implausible explanation (難以置信的解釋)
column5: im 不 + plausible 值得鼓掌的：說法爛到沒人鼓掌
column8: 難以置信的；不合常理的

column2: Her theory is tenable only if the missing letters are found.
column3: 只有找到遺失的信件，她的理論才站得住腳。
column4: a tenable position (站得住腳的立場)
column5: ten 握住：理論像城堡，能被守住就是 tenable

column2: After the new data came out, the mayor's position became untenable.
column3: 新數據公布後，市長的立場變得站不住腳。
column4: an untenable position (站不住腳的立場)
column5: un 不 + tenable 守得住：城牆被攻破，守不住了

column2: The fingerprints provided conclusive proof that the jewels had been moved.
column3: 指紋提供了確鑿的證據，證明寶石曾被移動過。
column5: conclude 下結論 + ive：證據硬到不用再吵

column2: The first experiment was inconclusive, so the team repeated it with more samples.
column3: 第一次實驗沒有定論，所以團隊用更多樣本重做了一次。
column5: in 不 + conclusive：吵半天，還是沒有結論

column2: This biography is considered the definitive account of the poet's life.
column3: 這本傳記被視為這位詩人生平的權威記述。
column5: define 定義 + ive：一錘定音的最終版

column2: A provisional bridge of planks let villagers cross while the stone one was rebuilt.
column3: 一座木板搭成的臨時橋，讓村民在石橋重建期間得以通行。
column5: pro 事先 + vision 看：先看著辦、先湊合用的暫時版

column2: The jury's verdict was unequivocal: all twelve members voted to acquit.
column3: 陪審團的裁決毫不含糊：十二位成員全數投票主張無罪。
column5: un 不 + equi 相等 + voc 聲音：只有一種聲音，沒有兩種說法

column2: The sign's wording was ambiguous, so tourists could not tell whether to turn left or right.
column3: 路標的措辭含混不清，所以遊客分不出該左轉還是右轉。
column5: ambi 兩邊：兩條路都說得通，所以搞不清楚

column2: The professor's perspicuous explanation made the difficult theorem easy to follow.
column3: 教授清晰明白的解說，讓艱深的定理變得容易跟上。
column5: per 穿透 + spic 看：一眼就能看穿，毫無障礙

column2: The contract was written in opaque legal language that no ordinary reader could follow.
column3: 這份合約用晦澀難懂的法律語言寫成，一般讀者根本看不懂。
column5: 像毛玻璃：光透不過去，你也看不清裡面是什麼

column2: The thick fog obscured the lighthouse, so the sailors steered by the sound of bells.
column3: 濃霧遮蔽了燈塔，所以水手們靠著鐘聲來掌舵。
column5: ob 在上面 + scure 蓋住：蓋住了就看不清楚

column2: A good translator catches every nuance of tone that the original author intended.
column3: 好的譯者能捕捉原作者想傳達的每一種語氣細微差別。
column5: 讀音像「扭昂斯」：語氣稍微扭一點，意思就差一點

column2: Her nuanced review praised the film's acting while questioning its slow ending.
column3: 她細膩有層次的評論稱讚了影片的演技，同時質疑結尾太慢。
column5: nuance 加 -d：不是黑白二分，而是有漸層的灰

column2: The treaty delineates the border between the two countries in exact detail.
column3: 這項條約精確地劃定了兩國之間的邊界。
column5: de + line 線 + ate：拿筆沿著線畫出輪廓

column2: The mural depicts farmers harvesting rice under a golden sun.
column3: 這幅壁畫描繪了農夫在金色陽光下收割稻米的情景。
column5: depict 裡藏著 pict，像 picture 圖畫：用畫面呈現

column2: The novel portrays the general as a lonely man haunted by his choices.
column3: 這部小說把將軍刻畫成一個被自己的抉擇所困擾的孤獨男人。
column4: portray someone as (把某人描寫成)
column5: 諧音「抱特雷」：抱著角色的靈魂，把他演出來

column2: Long dry summers and mild winters characterize the region's climate.
column3: 漫長乾燥的夏季與溫和的冬季，是這個地區氣候的特徵。
column5: character 特徵 + ize 動詞化：替它貼上特徵標籤

column2: Bees can differentiate between flowers that hold nectar and those that do not.
column3: 蜜蜂能分辨哪些花有花蜜、哪些沒有。
column5: different 不同 + ate：把不同的東西分開來

column2: It took years of practice before she could distinguish a violin's tone from a viola's.
column3: 她練習了好幾年，才能分辨小提琴與中提琴的音色。
column5: dis 就是分開：把 A 和 B 分開來看，才分得出來

column2: Employers must not discriminate against applicants because of their age.
column3: 雇主不得因年齡而歧視求職者。
column5: against 站在對面：discriminate against 就是把人推到對面

column2: From the hilltop, we could barely discern the outline of the distant island.
column3: 從山頂上，我們幾乎看不出遠方島嶼的輪廓。
column5: dis 分開 + cern 篩：把細節從霧裡一點一點篩出來

column2: Many customers perceive the new logo as a sign of a modern company.
column3: 許多顧客把新標誌視為現代企業的象徵。
column5: per 徹底 + ceive 抓取（像 receive）：完全抓到感受

column2: After hours of debate, the senator conceded that the budget needed changes.
column3: 辯論數小時後，參議員承認預算需要修改。
column5: con + cede 讓出：讓出一步，承認對方有理

column2: The union accepted the company's concession and called off the strike.
column3: 工會接受了公司的讓步，並取消了罷工。
column5: concede 的名詞：各讓一步，罷工就結束了

column2: The company acknowledged its mistake and promised to refund every customer.
column3: 公司承認了自己的錯誤，並承諾退款給每位顧客。
column5: 諧音「啊，可惡累」：啊，我認了，是我的錯
